# Amazon Verified Permissions

Store policy stores, Cedar schemas, static policies and tags as records without the Cedar authorization engine.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `verifiedpermissions` |
| Signing name | `verifiedpermissions` |
| Wire protocol | AWS JSON 1.0 |
| API version | `2021-12-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Configuration records only |
| Selected operations | 15 of 34 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#amazon-verified-permissions) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Cedar schema validation is not performed in STRICT mode; schema definitions are stored as JSON records without validating policy syntax against Cedar entity/action schemas.
- Cedar authorization evaluation engine (IsAuthorized, IsAuthorizedWithToken, BatchIsAuthorized) is not implemented and will be delivered in a future slice.
- Template-linked policies and policy templates (CreatePolicyTemplate, GetPolicyTemplate, ListPolicyTemplates, UpdatePolicyTemplate, DeletePolicyTemplate) are not supported.
- Identity sources (CreateIdentitySource, GetIdentitySource, ListIdentitySources, UpdateIdentitySource, DeleteIdentitySource) are not supported.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
